key_insight: A single PhenOM foundation model supported thousands of validated prediction tasks across more than 1,770 outcomes, with 80% of tasks achieving AUROC ≥0.70.
clinical_relevance: The model could support broad patient-level risk assessment across specialties, but clinical benefit was not established in the abstract.
method: Trained on longitudinal medical-event data from more than 400 million patient records.
Evaluated Future Risk, Screening, Care Opportunity, and Treatment Effect tasks.
Measured AUROC on data excluded from training, using standardized codes to define outcomes where possible.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports 30% of tasks achieved AUROC ≥0.80 and presents 177 example tasks, with performance varying by outcome and clinical domain.
watch_item: AUROC alone does not establish calibration, clinical utility, or generalizability to new care settings.
paper_title: Performance of a foundation model to generate thousands of predicted outcomes across multiple use cases
